name: Support Command Desk
description: Classify a local ticket queue by intent, sentiment, SLA risk, and legal language, then write an escalation, a priority packet, or an auto-reply.

parameters.content:
## Queue
Twenty-eight sample tickets. Sentiment and intent are already on the row so the desk can run without an AI credential.

## Routing
Legal language, very negative sentiment, or an angry VIP goes to a person. Repeat contacts and old tickets go to the priority queue. The rest get a drafted reply.
